items.title: Finding the Mean of a Dataset of Large Numbers (Word Problems)

sections.normalized_html:
The dataset below shows the file sizes, in megabytes (MB), of four different software packages:

[MATH: 1\,580,\: 1\,620,\: 1\,600,\: 1\,610]

What is the mean file size?
sections.readable_text:
The dataset below shows the file sizes, in megabytes (MB), of four different software packages:

[MATH: 1\,580,\: 1\,620,\: 1\,600,\: 1\,610]

What is the mean file size?

sections.normalized_html:
The mean (or average) is calculated by dividing the sum of all the data values by the number of values.

First, we add all the file sizes:

[MATH: 1\,580 + 1\,620 + 1\,600 + 1\,610 = 6\,410]

Then, we divide this total by the number of values. Since there are [MATH: 4] values, the mean is

[MATH: \textrm{Mean} = \dfrac{6\,410}{4} = 1\,602.5.]

Therefore, the mean file size is [MATH: 1\,602.5\textrm{ MB}.]
